Warning symbols and definitions: the safety alert symbol, DANGER (will result in death or serious injury), WARNING (could result in death or serious injury), CAUTION (could result in minor or moderate injury) and NOTICE (practices not related to personal injury) as they look in the manual

Important safety information, General Safety items 1 to 8: read the instructions, keep children away, place the welder on a stable surface, do not overreach, stay alert and sober, avoid unintentional starting, never leave the welder energized and unattended, and use common sense

Fume and gas safety (items 1 to 6): welding fumes are toxic, do not use near degreasing or painting, keep your head out of the fumes, use enough ventilation or an approved respirator, and work in a confined area only if well ventilated

Arc ray safety (items 1 to 6): wear ANSI-approved eye protection with at least a number 10 shade lens, leather leggings and fire resistant shoes, clothing free of grease and oil, a head covering, a welding jacket or long sleeves, and ear plugs when welding overhead or in confined spaces

Electrical safety (items 1 to 10): electric shock can kill; turn off and disconnect power, do not touch energized parts, use a grounded GFCI-protected supply, do not use near water, pacemaker warning, do not expose to rain, do not abuse the cord, do not use outdoors, and insulate yourself from the workpiece

Fire safety (items 1 to 9): arc and slag can cause fire; clear flammable objects for 35 feet (10 meters), keep an ABC-type fire extinguisher near, do not weld on combustible coatings, do not put hot slag in containers of combustibles, and examine the area for fire after welding

Welder use and care (items 1 to 6): do not use the welder if the switch does not work, disconnect the plug before adjustments, prevent unintentional starting, store it away from children, use it as instructed, and do not use it for pipe thawing
Maintenance safety rules (items 1 to 4): maintain the welder, have it serviced with identical replacement parts, keep labels and nameplates readable, and unplug it before maintenance

Gas shielded welding cylinder safety (items 1 to 7): cylinders can explode when damaged; do not weld on a pressurized cylinder, keep the cap on, keep cylinders away from electrical circuits, use the right gas equipment, protect cylinders from heat; SAVE THESE INSTRUCTIONS

Grounding WARNING (items 1 and 2) to prevent electric shock: check the outlet is properly grounded and never modify the plug; Extension Cords: do not use an extension cord on this welder; Replacement Cords (items 1 to 3): use only a supplied or identical cord, no thinner or longer cord, and do not patch cords together
